title: Overalls Season, Officially
description: A fall overalls outfit: chocolate corduroy overalls with tiny embroidered flowers, a sage green fitted tee, a chunky cable knit beanie, a slouchy brown hobo bag, layered gold necklaces and suede retro sneakers.
intro: Overalls have a reputation problem. Either they look like you are about to paint a fence, or they look like a costume. Corduroy fixes it. These are chocolate brown, wide leg, with tiny cream and yellow embroidered flowers scattered down the legs, and they look like something you chose on purpose. Add a fitted sage tee, a chunky beanie, a slouchy bag and gold at the neckline, and it is the pumpkin patch outfit that still works at the grocery store.

sections.heading: The overalls are the whole outfit
paragraphs: CIDER wide-leg corduroy overalls in Coffee, with a bib pocket, adjustable straps and little embroidered flowers. Corduroy is the difference: it has texture and warmth, so it reads fall and grown up instead of farm chore. This is a newer listing with fewer reviews, so check the size chart before you order.

sections.heading: A fitted top underneath
paragraphs: The Trendy Queen long sleeve crew neck in Light Green is fitted and soft, with more than 8,000 ratings. Sage under chocolate brown is the colour combination that makes the whole outfit look styled. A fitted layer keeps the overalls from swallowing you.

sections.heading: The cosy extras
paragraphs: The C.C beanie is chunky cable knit in an oatmeal cream with its little leather patch on the cuff, and it has over 9,000 ratings for a reason. The hobo bag is soft vegan leather in Coffee, slouchy, one strap, big enough for a wallet, keys, snacks and a water bottle.
The necklace set is three layers in 14K gold plating: a paperclip chain, a fine sparkle chain and a long chain with a small open pendant. It shows at the neckline of the tee and catches the light.

sections.heading: Shoes you can walk a pumpkin patch in
paragraphs: The TIMEJOY retro sneakers are beige suede with a white side stripe and a gum sole. Flat, comfortable and the right colour to go with brown and green without looking like hiking boots.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the overalls, the long sleeve top, the beanie, the hobo bag, the necklace set and the sneakers. The floors, cabinets, rug, blanket, yarn basket, pumpkins, hay bales, scrunchie, tumbler and the dog are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
